findings.detail: A01 is treating source subtotal and disposition rows as failed rollups even though the disclosed current-period fair-value arithmetic is exact.

rationale: Raw source decides the issue. Table 4 row 21 discloses debt fair value of 86,897,322 and table 5 row 30 discloses equity fair value of 162,797,111; these sum exactly to the debt-and-equity subtotal of 249,694,433 at table 5 row 31. Adding cash equivalents of 1,906,618 at row 34 and short-term investments of 321,170,326 at row 37 gives exactly the disclosed total investments fair value of 572,771,377 at row 38. The independent fair-value hierarchy total at table 19 row 7 is 572,771 in thousands, agreeing after rounding. Thus the filing arithmetic is correct and the six zero-FV-residual A01 failures are a row-disposition/rule-scope false alarm, not a source data error.
